description: LDAPS channel binding calibration profile for CBT never/when-supported/always modes.

states.name: cbt_never_expected_invalid_credentials
states.why: LDAPS rejected synthetic credentials while CBT evidence was available but no CBT-specific diagnostic was observed.
limitations: This may also describe compatible CBT when-supported behavior; compare against a no-CBT or malformed-CBT baseline before promotion.

states.name: cbt_always_bad_bindings
states.why: LDAPS returned a CBT-related diagnostic such as 80090346 or SEC_E_BAD_BINDINGS.
limitations: Promotion requires the diagnostic to be stable for CBT always mode in the lab and absent in CBT never mode.
